# Asset sources

- `inter-latin.woff2`: Inter Variable, https://github.com/rsms/inter — SIL Open Font License, see `Inter-OFL.txt`.
- `display-zh.woff2`: Noto Sans SC 900, subset of the characters used on this site, via https://fonts.googleapis.com — SIL Open Font License, see `NotoSansSC-OFL.txt`. Regenerate it after adding new Chinese headings (see README).
- `covers/rag-hub.jpg`: screenshot of `docs/zhishu-prototype.html` in nepheloovo/rag_hub.
- `covers/pinterest.jpg`: screenshot of https://nepheloovo.github.io/pinterest-landing/.
- `covers/attachment.jpg`: screenshot of nepheloovo/attachment-style `index.html`.
- `covers/article-*.jpg`: cover images of the author's own WeChat articles (公众号「小渡ovo」).
